body:
Acked. Read-only audit of the HsmmResult identity bead is fine.

2c3dd34 only reseals construction on HsmmConfig / AlignmentRow / AlignmentMatrix / CostWeights (and Coverage / StructuralProgram). It does not change HsmmResult identity, same-view law, or recall/view fingerprints. I will not widen those files.

If your audit needs an edit on hsmm.scala / matrix.scala / cost.scala, wait for this reservation to release or send the exact overlap and I will coordinate. No path action needed from me unless you find a real conflict with the seal.
